about.title: About Us - Scene Memory
about.subtitle: We preserve your most precious moments, scene after scene
about.text1: At Scene Memory, we believe the most beautiful moments of life deserve to be kept with clarity and emotion. We are more than just a storage platform – we are a digital memory album for the journey of your life.

features.immersiveAlbums: Create immersive memory albums containing photos, videos, and voice notes
features.aiOrganize: AI-powered organization that automatically classifies and tags your memories
features.privacy: Complete privacy and security – your memories are encrypted and accessible only to you

hero.description: At Scene Memory, we believe every moment deserves to last. We're here to help you preserve, organize, and remember the important events in your life.

our_story.title: How Our Journey Began
our_story.intro: Our story started with a simple idea: how can we help people preserve the precious memories that shape their lives?
our_story.stage1_desc: In 2020, our founders noticed how many important moments fade over time. They decided to build a simple yet powerful tool to preserve them.
our_story.stage2_desc: As more users joined, we added smart reminders, advanced categorization, and secure sharing with loved ones.
our_story.stage3_desc: Today, we aim to be the world's best platform for preserving and organizing memories, with a strong focus on privacy and seamless experience.

mission_vision.mission_text: Our mission is to empower every person to preserve their precious memories in an easy, secure, and organized way. We believe every moment in our lives deserves to be kept and remembered.
mission_vision.value_people_first_desc: User experience guides every decision we make
mission_vision.value_privacy_desc: Your memories stay yours alone – we never share them
mission_vision.value_growth_desc: We keep evolving to meet our users' needs
mission_vision.vision_text: We aspire to be the world's leading platform for preserving and organizing memories, where anyone, anywhere, can easily and securely keep their important moments.
